title: HDX-guided EPR Spectroscopy for Membrane Protein Dynamics
author: Lane, Wang, et al.

steps.title: Prepare ampicillin stock
steps.instruction: Make 10 mL of ampicillin stock at 100 mg/mL.

steps.title: Make LB agar plates with ampicillin
steps.instruction: Prepare LB agar (per L: 10 g tryptone, 5 g yeast extract, 10 g NaCl, 12 g agar) and add ampicillin to a final 100 µg/mL using the stock; pour plates.

steps.title: Prepare LB broth
steps.instruction: Make 1 L LB broth (10 g tryptone, 5 g yeast extract, 10 g NaCl) in a Duran bottle.

steps.title: Autoclave LB media
steps.instruction: Dispense nine 500 mL portions of LB broth into 2 L growth flasks, cover with foil, and autoclave.

steps.title: Introduce mutations by site‑directed mutagenesis
steps.instruction: Use site‑directed mutagenesis to introduce the required mutations (e.g., L89W) into plasmid pJ411:140126‑TbMscL; primers are listed in the key resources table.

steps.title: Prepare BL21(DE3) competent cells
steps.instruction: Make or obtain BL21(DE3) chemically competent cells for transformation.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Create the following stocks and store as indicated:

substeps.instruction: 500 mL 3 M NaCl, filter 0.22 µm, store 4 °C (up to 3 months).
500 mL 500 mM sodium phosphate, pH 7.5, filter 0.22 µm, store 4 °C (up to 3 months).
50 % glycerol stock.
500 mL 1× PBS.
50 mL 1 M imidazole.
20 mL 1 % DDM, store –20 °C (up to 6 months).
70 % ethanol for cell‑disruptor cleaning.
1 % Teepol for cell‑disruptor cleaning.
100 mM MTSSL in DMSO, store –80 °C.
Fill a 1 L Duran bottle with mqH₂O and keep at 4 °C for ice‑cold buffers.

steps.title: Recharge Ni‑NTA gravity column
steps.instruction: Wash and condition the Ni‑NTA column as follows:

substeps.instruction: Wash with 0.5 M NaOH, 15 column volumes.
Wash with mqH₂O, 15 column volumes.
Wash with stripping buffer (50 mM sodium phosphate, 300 mM NaCl, 100 mM EDTA, pH 8.0), 10 column volumes.
Wash with mqH₂O, 20 column volumes.
Wash with 100 mM NiSO₄ in mqH₂O, 2 column volumes.
Final wash with mqH₂O, 10 column volumes.

steps.title: Prepare clean EPR tube
steps.instruction: Obtain a clean, dry EPR tube for sample loading.

steps.title: Verify protein is spin‑labeled
steps.instruction: Confirm that the protein sample has been reacted with MTSSL (or other spin label).

steps.title: Pre‑cool cryostat
steps.instruction: Ensure sufficient liquid nitrogen or helium is available and pre‑cool the EPR spectrometer cryostat (≈4–6 h).

steps.title: Prepare quench buffer for HDX‑MS
steps.instruction: Make 50 mM potassium phosphate, 300 mM NaCl, 0.1 % DDM, pH 2.2, ice‑cold; aliquot 10 mL, store at –20 °C (up to 6 months) and thaw immediately before use.

steps.title: Prepare deuterated labeling buffer
steps.instruction: Make 50 mM potassium phosphate, 300 mM NaCl, 0.05 % DDM, pH 7.4 in D₂O; aliquot 10 mL, store at –20 °C (up to 6 months) and thaw immediately before use.

steps.title: Prepare pepsin column wash buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 5 % acetonitrile, 1.2 % formic acid, 0.05 % DDM.

steps.title: Calibrate mass spectrometer
steps.instruction: Follow the manufacturer’s instructions to calibrate the MS instrument.

steps.title: Set up LC‑MS for HDX
steps.instruction: Configure the LC system with a switching valve for online pepsin digestion, a cooled compartment (~0 °C) for reverse‑phase chromatography, and interface it to a high‑resolution mass spectrometer (e.g., Waters LC‑MS with LEAP robot and Synapt G2‑Si).

steps.title: Check sequence coverage with unlabeled protein
steps.instruction: Inject the new protein three times without deuterium labeling and verify adequate peptide coverage.

steps.title: Thaw cell pellet and resuspend
steps.instruction: Thaw the harvested cell pellet and resuspend in PBS at 20 mL per 500 mL culture; vortex to mix.

steps.title: Homogenize cell suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the suspension to a Duran bottle, add a magnetic stir bar, and stir in a cold room for 15–20 min.

steps.title: Lyse cells with high‑pressure disruptor
steps.instruction: Pass the suspension through an Avestin Emulisflex C3 continuous‑flow disruptor at 15 000 psi, 4 °C, twice.

steps.title: Clean cell disruptor
steps.instruction: Flush the disruptor sequentially with mqH₂O, 1 % Teepol, then mqH₂O.

steps.title: Clarify lysate by low‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Transfer lysate to 50 mL Falcon tubes and centrifuge at 4 700 × g, 4 °C, 20 min.

steps.title: Pellet membranes by ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Move the supernatant to pre‑weighed Beckman ultracentrifuge tubes, balance them, and spin at 100 000 × g, 4 °C, 1 h.

steps.title: Determine membrane mass
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, weigh the tubes with pellet, and calculate the membrane mass; keep homogenizer and spatula on ice during this step.

steps.title: Prepare solubilization buffer
steps.instruction: For each gram of membrane, make 25 mL of buffer containing 50 mM Na‑phosphate (pH 7.5), 300 mM NaCl, 10 % glycerol, 50 mM imidazole, 1.5 % DDM; keep on ice and prepare fresh each time.

steps.title: Distribute solubilization buffer
steps.instruction: Add half of the prepared solubilization buffer to each ultracentrifuge tube; the remaining half will later be used to wash the membranes.

steps.title: Scrape and collect membranes
steps.instruction: Using a spatula, gently scrape membrane from tube walls and decant into a pre‑cooled glass homogenizer.

steps.title: Homogenize membranes
steps.instruction: Homogenize until no visible membrane fragments remain.

steps.title: Incubate membranes on roller
steps.instruction: Transfer homogenate to 50 mL Falcon tubes, seal tightly, and roll at 4 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Centrifuge solubilized membranes
steps.instruction: Spin at 4 700 × g, 4 °C, 20 min in a benchtop centrifuge.

steps.title: Load onto Ni‑NTA column
steps.instruction: Pass the solubilized membrane through a gravity column containing 1 mL (≈2 mL suspension) pre‑equilibrated Ni²⁺‑NTA resin.

steps.title: Prepare SEC buffer
steps.instruction: Make 50 mM Na‑phosphate (pH 7.5), 300 mM NaCl, 0.05 % DDM; degas ≥1 h (≈250 mL for a Superdex 200 10/300 column) and keep at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 2× purification buffer (HDX‑MS only)
steps.instruction: Make 20 mL of 100 mM Na‑phosphate (pH 7.5), 600 mM NaCl, 20 % glycerol, 0.1 % DDM; prepare fresh each time.

steps.title: Make wash and elution buffers (HDX‑MS)
steps.instruction: From the 2× buffer prepare:

substeps.instruction: Wash buffer (25 mL): 12.5 mL 2× buffer + 1.25 mL 1 M imidazole + 11.25 mL mqH₂O.
Elution buffer (6 mL): 3 mL 2× buffer + 1.8 mL 1 M imidazole + 1.2 mL mqH₂O (final 300 mM imidazole).

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer for EPR
steps.instruction: Make 50 mL of wash buffer (50 mM Na‑phosphate pH 7.5, 300 mM NaCl, 10 % glycerol, 0.05 % DDM, 50 mM imidazole) and degas ≥1 h.

steps.title: Make MTSSL wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mM MTSSL (from 100 mM stock) to 4 mL of the degassed wash buffer.

steps.title: Make TCEP wash buffer
steps.instruction: Add 3 mM TCEP (from 100 mM stock) to 4 mL of the degassed wash buffer.

steps.title: Prepare elution buffer for EPR
steps.instruction: Make 6 mL of elution buffer (same composition as wash buffer but with 300 mM imidazole).

steps.title: Wash Ni column after binding
steps.instruction: After protein binding, pass wash buffer through the column:

substeps.instruction: For HDX‑MS: 25 mL wash buffer, then pause.
For EPR: initially 10 mL wash buffer before labeling steps.

steps.title: Keep nickel bed covered
steps.instruction: Maintain the Ni‑NTA resin continuously covered with buffer (critical).

steps.title: Optional SEC column pre‑equilibration
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the SEC column with 1.2 column volumes of SEC buffer before any pause.

steps.title: Label protein on column (EPR only)
steps.instruction: Perform the following labeling sequence on the Ni‑NTA column:

substeps.instruction: Pass 4 mL TCEP wash buffer through the column.
When TCEP is nearly eluted, add 5 mL wash buffer to remove most TCEP.
Add 4 mL MTSSL wash buffer; allow ~2 mL to replace the column buffer, then cap.
Remove column from 4 °C, incubate at 16–25 °C for 15 min.
Return column to 4 °C and incubate 12–20 h, keeping the resin covered with buffer.
Next morning, uncapped column, allow the remaining ~2 mL MTSSL buffer to replace the resin buffer.
Cap column and incubate again at 16–25 °C for 15 min.
Wash with 20 mL wash buffer to remove excess MTSSL.

steps.title: Pause point after labeling
steps.instruction: The Ni‑NTA column can remain in wash buffer for 12–20 h until the next morning.

steps.title: Equilibrate SEC column (if not done)
steps.instruction: Run 1.2 column volumes of SEC buffer through the SEC column before elution.

steps.title: Elute protein from Ni column
steps.instruction: Add elution buffer without disturbing the resin and collect eight 1 mL fractions (E1–E8).

steps.title: Measure protein concentration
steps.instruction: Record UV/Vis spectra of each fraction (E1–E8) on a Nanodrop to estimate concentrations.

steps.title: Concentrate pooled protein
steps.instruction: Combine protein‑containing fractions and concentrate with a Vivaspin‑2 (100 kDa MWCO) to ~800 µL at 3 500 × g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Run size‑exclusion chromatography
steps.instruction: Inject the concentrated sample onto a Superdex 200 column (e.g., 10/300 GL) pre‑equilibrated with SEC buffer; flow at 0.5 mL/min.

steps.title: Collect SEC elution peak
steps.instruction: Collect the MscL peak (elutes at 12 mL on a 10/300 GL column or 65 mL on a 16/60 column).

steps.title: Finalize protein concentration
steps.instruction: Pool the MscL fractions and concentrate to 50–100 µM monomer for EPR spectroscopy or to 16 µM for HDX‑MS.
